description: A standing-room slot of chrome and steam, all counter and no chairs, built to move you through fast and caffeinated. A semi-automated espresso rig does most of the work while a barista babysits it and judges your order. The menu board overhead recalculates its prices with a soft chime that has trained regulars to flinch. It smells of scorched sugar, ozone, and other people's mornings.
name: Jitter
